title: Design System: Magic Tree House Viewer

display.purpose: Sticky chapter title on the departure board (Barlow Condensed 600).

headline.purpose: Product name and board section titles in condensed uppercase.

title.purpose: Pager chapter titles and mid-weight board meta.

body.purpose: English chapter prose in Charter/Iowan; default 18px, 66ch measure.

label.purpose: Board switches, column headers, time phrases, figure notes.

shadows.name: board-sticky
shadows.purpose: Soft drop under the sticky departure board only.

components.name: Board Switch
components.description: Ink-board control for language, size, and express; pressed fills signal yellow.
components.css: .ds-switch-well { display: inline-flex; gap: 0; padding: 2px; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: #1d2b36; font-family: "Barlow Condensed", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-board-switch { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: transparent; color: #a9b5bd; font-family: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-board-switch:hover { background: #2c3b47; color: #eef1ee; } .ds-board-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4c21b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-board-switch-on, .ds-board-switch[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #f4c21b; color: #15212b; }

components.name: Board Switch Pressed
components.description: Pressed board switch: signal fill, ink text.
components.css: .ds-board-switch-pressed { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: #f4c21b; color: #15212b; font-family: "Barlow Condensed", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.025em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-board-switch-pressed:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-board-switch-pressed:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b7182; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Timetable Row
components.description: Four-column book row on the ink timetable; current row is a signal bar.
components.html: No.出发书名收藏
components.css: .ds-tt { background: #15212b; color: #eef1ee; font-family: system-ui, "PingFang SC", sans-serif; width: 340px; } .ds-tt-head, .ds-tt-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px 76px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 24px; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; text-align: left; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #2c3b47; } .ds-tt-head { font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a9b5bd; padding-bottom: 8px; } .ds-tt-row { background: transparent; color: #eef1ee; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-tt-row:hover { background: #1d2b36; } .ds-tt-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4c21b; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tt-no { font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #a9b5bd; } .ds-tt-time { font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tt-kept { font-family: "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #f4c21b; } .ds-tt-row-current { background: #f4c21b; color: #15212b; } .ds-tt-row-current .ds-tt-no, .ds-tt-row-current .ds-tt-kept { color: #15212b; }

components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; background: #15212b; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: system-ui, "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 36px; top: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px; transform: translateY(-50%); color: #a9b5bd; pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0 12px 0 36px; border: 1px solid #2c3b47; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: #1d2b36; color: #eef1ee; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #a9b5bd; } .ds-search-input:hover { border-color: #5b7182; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { border-color: #f4c21b; }

components.css: .ds-line { margin: 0 0 1em; font-family: Charter, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.7; color: #15212b; } .ds-fav-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 0.8em; height: 1.1em; margin-left: -0.05em; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; vertical-align: -0.12em; color: #9aa1a3; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 2px; transition: opacity 0.15s ease-out, color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-fav-btn svg { width: 0.62em; height: 0.82em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-line:hover .ds-fav-btn { opacity: 0.5; } .ds-fav-btn:hover, .ds-fav-btn:focus-visible { opacity: 1; color: #15212b; } .ds-fav-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b7182; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-fav-btn-on { margin-left: 0.15em; opacity: 1; color: #15212b; } .ds-fav-btn-on svg { fill: #f4c21b; }

components.name: Route Line
components.description: Chapter stops on a muted track; signal disc marks here; kept stops grow a signal tick.
components.css: .ds-route { position: relative; height: 22px; margin: 0 11px; background: #15212b; } .ds-route::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 3px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: #a9b5bd; opacity: 0.55; } .ds-stop { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 13px; height: 13px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 999px; border: 3px solid #a9b5bd; background: #15212b; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease-out, background-color 0.2s ease-out; } .ds-stop:hover { border-color: #eef1ee; } .ds-stop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4c21b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-stop-kept::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: calc(100% + 11px); width: 3px; height: 7px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: #f4c21b; } .ds-here { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 22px; height: 22px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 999px; background: #f4c21b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #15212b; pointer-events: none; transition: left 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); }

components.name: Pager Link
components.description: Prev/next chapter under an ink hairline; board label + condensed title.
components.css: .ds-pager { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-top: 56px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid #15212b; background: #f4f3ee; } .ds-pager-link { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: transparent; color: #15212b; cursor: pointer; font-family: "Barlow Condensed", "PingFang SC", sans-serif; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-pager-link:hover { background: #e7e6df; } .ds-pager-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b7182; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pager-next { align-items: flex-end; text-align: right; } .ds-pager-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #56616a; } .ds-pager-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; }

narrative.overview:
Every book is a departure whose time already lives in its title. The viewer is an ink timetable wrapped around a calm reading column — not a generic e-reader with a grey sidebar, white page, and blue accent. Signage lives on the dark board; English reading lives on cool timetable stock.

Density stays timetable-tight in chrome (condensed caps, tabular figures, four-column rows) and book-calm in the column (serif English, quiet Chinese underlines). One signal yellow marks only where you are and what you kept. Depth is mostly tonal: ink against stock, with a single soft sticky shadow on the departure board.
keyCharacteristics: Ink frame (#15212b) for sidebar and sticky departure board; stock ground (#f4f3ee) for reading
Barlow Condensed for all board/signage; Charter/Iowan for English; PingFang for Chinese
Signal yellow spent only on current position and kept sentences
Route blue-grey (#5b7182) for the line, focus rings, and reveal borders — never saturated blue
66ch reading measure; unkept bookmark tabs hidden until hover/focus

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Signal yellow marks only current position and kept sentences. It is never a general accent, link color, or decorative wash.

rules.name: The Route-Not-Blue Rule
rules.body: Navigation structure uses route blue-grey, not saturated UI blue. Focus, caret, and reveal borders follow --route.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Board chrome is always Barlow Condensed; reading English is always the serif stack. Do not put reading body in the condensed face, or board titles in the serif.

rules.name: The English-First Type Rule
rules.body: Chinese is smaller and cooler; it assists and never matches English weight or size.

rules.name: The Four-Column Rule
rules.body: The book list is always No. | 出发 | 书名 | 收藏. Do not collapse into a single-title list or invent extra columns.

rules.name: The Sixty-Six Rule
rules.body: Continuous reading stays inside a 66ch measure. Do not full-bleed body prose across the main pane.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Timetable rows and reading surfaces stay flat at rest. Do not add offset card shadows to list rows or paragraph blocks.

rules.name: The Tab-Not-Star Rule
rules.body: Kept sentences use the bookmark-tab silhouette. Do not substitute stars, hearts, or pill badges for the keep mark.

dos: Do spend signal yellow only on current row/stop/switch and kept tabs or express highlights.
Do keep the reading column at 66ch with English serif + quieter Chinese beneath.
Do hide unkept bookmark tabs until hover, focus, or touch affordance.
Do treat the sticky ink board + stock column as the default chrome/page split.
donts: Don't use saturated blue, purple gradients, or generic e-reader grey/white/blue accents.
Don't show idle keep marks in the reading line as permanent grey chrome.
Don't put continuous body copy in Barlow Condensed or board titles in the reading serif.
Don't widen the book list beyond the four timetable columns or drop the departure time phrase.
